reviews.title: Not for jeep-do not recommend
reviews.comment: Purchased due to reviews saying it worked for a Jeep Grand Cherokee L-2022.  Well it does fit, but somehow the middle section of the wiper does not stay in contact w/the window. Leaving a big section that does not get cleared. Lesson learned-buy the wiper that is for your vehicle. So here is my warning...Jeep owners-buy correct wiper. Otherwise, quality is good and installation was easy.
